text:
Developer-Emma: main pipeline turned red right after merging PR #4567, smoke step failed on docker build on linux-arm64. anyone around? :eyes:
CI Bot: build/12345 FAILED - step `docker:build-smoke` exit code 1
CI Bot: logs: `ERROR: failed to copy layers: unexpected EOF from content digest` (link: https://ci.redwood.dev/build/12345)
Sam: on it, re-running the job now to rule out transient network pull issues
Sam: rerun triggered: build/12346
Maria: quick question — was there any base image bump in that PR? commit hash?
Developer-Emma: commit 9f2c3bd, only small doc tweak + a Dockerfile reorder to consolidate layers (moved curl before pip install)
Alex: hmm moving ephemeral curl earlier could change layer checksums, but shouldn't produce EOF. could be cache corruption on the runner. try `docker build --no-cache`
Tilly-Oncall: I can take this if rerun flakes. Sam, if build/12346 fails, please leave it so I can bisect across recent merges
Sam: build/12346 FAILED with same error. attaching short excerpt:
```
failed to register layer: apply diffs: failed to copy: unexpected EOF
...
```
Developer-Emma: that matches my local reproduce on arm64 qemu, btw. on amd64 it was fine. could be a cross-arch cache oddity
Maria: OK — two paths: force no-cache on the smoke job, or bisect which merge introduced the bad base/cache. Tilly, you want me to roll the job with `--no-cache` first?
Tilly-Oncall: yes please, roll with no-cache and pin to the runner that builds amd64 and arm64 separately. ping me the job id when done.
Alex: another quick check: can we `docker pull` the base image manually on the runner and validate digest? sometimes registries return truncated layers for a short window
Sam: kicked off build/12347 with `--no-cache` and explicit `--platform=linux/arm64` on the dedicated arm runner
CI Bot: build/12347 RUNNING (no-cache)
Sam: build/12347 PASSED on no-cache. so cache corruption is likely.
Developer-Emma: thanks. sounds like a runner-level corrupted cache. we should invalidate the layer cache on the arm runners and re-run smoke with cache enabled to confirm
Tilly-Oncall: I'll schedule a rolling cache invalidation for arm pool in 15m and monitor. leaving a checklist: 1) invalidate cache on arm runners 2) re-run build/12348 (cache on) 3) if fails, bisect between last two merges.
Maria: tagging infra-maintenance that this is cache corruption, not a code regression yet. :heavy_check_mark:
Alex: FYI adding a short note to the PR that Dockerfile reorder can interact poorly with shared layer caches across archs — not blocking but helpful context
Developer-Emma: appreciated. once cache is cleared I'll re-open a quick PR to move the curl back after pip to keep layers stable
Tilly-Oncall: cache invalidation started. will post updates here after sweep completes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
CI Bot: cache sweep job/999 started on arm-pool
Tilly-Oncall: sweep done. re-running build/12348 (cache enabled) now
CI Bot: build/12348 PASSED on arm (cache restored)
Developer-Emma: awesome — closing the loop. thanks everyone for quick responses.
Tilly-Oncall: leaving a follow-up issue to add a small smoke step that builds with both `--no-cache` and with cache for cross-arch parity checks. I'll create it after standup.
Maria: noted, assigning to Tilly.
